title: Documents and multiple uploads
summary: Tickets and cases in every service now take documents as well as screenshots and screencasts, several files at a time, with a new drag-and-drop upload box that shows each file's progress.
changes: Attach documents (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, ODT, ODS, TXT and CSV) when you open a ticket or case, reply to a ticket or add a case update. Files with macros, older Word and Excel formats and programs are refused.
Attach up to 10 screenshots of 5 MB each, 3 screencasts of 50 MB each and 10 documents of 10 MB each, up to 100 MB in one go.

A new upload box on every ticket and case form: drag and drop or choose files, remove a file before sending, see the limits up front and follow each file's progress. It works with a keyboard and screen readers.
Uploads now work in APES Shelter and Rescue and APES Pet Care Clinic as well as APES CIC. Admins can turn uploads off for a service on Admin, Modules.
Files added with a staff-only note or an internal case update are visible to staff only. The person who uploaded a file, or an admin, can delete it.
Uploads can be checked for viruses before anyone can download them, and blocked files are held back with a message to the uploader.
Screenshots and photos are resized to at most 2560 pixels and saved without location data or other hidden image details.

Uploads, downloads and deletions are recorded in the audit log. The save message says how many files were uploaded, and update emails say how many new attachments there are, with a link to log in and view them.
version_rationale: Minor: new capabilities (document uploads, multiple files, uploads in every service, virus scanning support and an admin upload switch) with no breaking changes.
validation: Feature tests for document types and macros, upload limits, the shared upload component, uploads in every service, attachment permissions and staff-only files, virus scan states and quarantine, audit entries, email wording and image resizing.
Frontend unit tests for the upload component with node --test, and a browser check of ticket and admin pages on Laragon.
Full PHPUnit suite locally and in CI; release history validated against main.
known_limitations: Virus scanning needs a ClamAV daemon that the app can reach. Until one is configured, new files are marked not scanned and can be downloaded; see the Attachments and virus scanning wiki page.
Files uploaded before this release are marked not scanned.
The older single screencast field is still accepted for this release only.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. The new attachment columns have defaults and can stay; documents and staff-only files uploaded on this release would then show to anyone who can see the record, so turn uploads off on Admin, Modules first if a rollback is needed.
provenance: Milestone v0.58.0 Beta: Documents and multiple uploads, epic #542 with sub-issues #543 to #553, pull request #695.
